<span id="introduction" style="display:block;height:0;overflow:hidden;line-height:0;"></span>
== <span style="padding:0.15em 0 0.35em;line-height:1.35;"><ins style="text-decoration:none;"><nowiki>Introduction</nowiki></ins></span> ==

<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>A pest hiding under Falador Park. The Giant Mole is an introductory boss aimed at lower-levelled players. She will dig to a different part of the arena for every phase, indicated by a dirt arrow on the ground. This boss can be fought with tier 50-60 gear as well. The main difference between Normal Mode and Hard Mode is that the Giant Mole hits a bit harder and more quickly in Hard Mode.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;height:0;overflow:hidden;margin:0;line-height:0;"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
</div><div style="margin:1.6em 0 2.2em;">
<span id="mechanics" style="display:block;height:0;overflow:hidden;line-height:0;"></span>
== <span style="padding:0.15em 0 0.35em;line-height:1.35;"><ins style="text-decoration:none;"><nowiki>Mechanics</nowiki></ins></span> ==

<div><div><div><u><nowiki>Attack Rotation</nowiki></u>
</div><div style="white-space:pre-line;"><nowiki>Giant Mole uses </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="melee">[[File:Melee icon.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1096130867279171706.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>melee</nowiki>|<nowiki>melee</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> auto attacks between mechanics. Her mechanics are based on the chamber she is in. In the last phase she will move to the central chamber and use all four mechanics, starting with Mini-Moles
</nowiki></div></div><div><div><u><nowiki>Burrow</nowiki></u>
</div><div style="white-space:pre-line;"><nowiki>Used after every phase.
⬥ The Giant Mole will burrow into the ground, going to another chamber in the arena. The player should:

• Follow the dusty trail and go to the chamber in that direction to continue the fight
    • </nowiki>[https://img.pvme.io/images/XRMV1fBCnz.mp4 <nowiki>Click to view an example of Burrow</nowiki>]
</div></div><div><div><u><nowiki>Mini-Moles</nowiki></u>
</div><div style="white-space:pre-line;"><nowiki>Used in the north-west chamber.
⬥ The Giant Mole will call in moles to fight against you. A message pop-up will say </nowiki><code style="font-size:1em;padding:0.1em 0.25em;"><nowiki>The Giant Mole calls for aid.</nowiki></code><nowiki>
⬥ The moles are weak for their combat level, having only 100 lifepoints and hitting max 200. While they are alive the Giant Mole has increased Defence and damage reduction, so it is advised for lower level players to kill them as quickly as possible. The player should:

• Use Area-of-Effect (AoE) abilities to kill the Mini Moles, such as </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;position:relative;" title="chain">https://files.catbox.moe/a6nuht.png<span class="pvme-export-media-meta" style="position:absolute;top:0;left:0;width:100%;height:100%;font-size:0;line-height:1;">[https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257440203401068566.png?v=1 <span style="display:block;width:100%;height:100%;">Image source</span>]</span></span><nowiki> and </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="dbreath">[[File:Dragon Breath.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533833391702017.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>dbreath</nowiki>|<nowiki>dbreath</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki>
    • </nowiki>[https://img.pvme.io/images/S2L7QwzZtP.mp4 <nowiki>Click to view an example of Mini-Moles</nowiki>]
</div></div><div><div><u><nowiki>Berserk</nowiki></u>
</div><div style="white-space:pre-line;"><nowiki>Used in the north-east chamber.
⬥ The giant mole will occasionally enter a berserk state where her attacks become stronger, more accurate and faster. This is indicated by her glowing red and green. She can be stunned as she enters this mode: a message pop-up will say </nowiki><code style="font-size:1em;padding:0.1em 0.25em;"><nowiki>The mole can now be stunned.</nowiki></code><nowiki> The message </nowiki><code style="font-size:1em;padding:0.1em 0.25em;"><nowiki>The mole seems to regain her balance.</nowiki></code><nowiki> will show as Berserk ends. The player could:
    • Optionally use stunning </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;position:relative;" title="stunicon">https://files.catbox.moe/a5tul8.png<span class="pvme-export-media-meta" style="position:absolute;top:0;left:0;width:100%;height:100%;font-size:0;line-height:1;">[https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/841419289428492369.png?v=1 <span style="display:block;width:100%;height:100%;">Image source</span>]</span></span><nowiki> abilities such as </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="asphyx">[[File:Asphyxiate.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533833072672778.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>asphyx</nowiki>|<nowiki>asphyx</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> or </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="soulstrike">[[File:Soul Strike.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809142376058910.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>soulstrike</nowiki>|<nowiki>soulstrike</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> to stop her attacks 
    • </nowiki>[https://img.pvme.io/images/EOqLJJ4yhs.mp4 <nowiki>Click to view an example of Berserk</nowiki>]
</div></div><div><div><u><nowiki>Rockfall</nowiki></u>
</div><div style="white-space:pre-line;"><nowiki>Used in the south-east chamber.
⬥ The Giant Mole stomps the ground, loosening the ceiling, causing the player to be pinned and hit by falling rubble. This will be preceded by the message: </nowiki><code style="font-size:1em;padding:0.1em 0.25em;"><nowiki>You hear a crumbling noise above.</nowiki></code><nowiki>
⬥ In Normal Mode, the main target becomes stunned and bound for 3.6 seconds. The player should:
    • Use </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="freedom">[[File:Freedom.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258240786434.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>freedom</nowiki>|<nowiki>freedom</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> or use </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="anti">[[File:Anticipation.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541306475151390.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>anti</nowiki>|<nowiki>anti</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> beforehand to free yourself.
    • </nowiki>[https://img.pvme.io/images/4VnevH9HQN.mp4 <nowiki>Click to view an example of NM rockfall</nowiki>]<nowiki>
⬥ In Hard Mode, the main target becomes trapped in mud. In this state, players may not move, attack, activate abilities or eat food but may still switch Prayers and drink potions.
    • Freeing can be done by another player, or the giant mole will after dealing up to 3,000 damage to you, with the message </nowiki><code style="font-size:1em;padding:0.1em 0.25em;"><nowiki>The Giant Mole strikes a mighty blow, shattering your muddy prison.</nowiki></code><nowiki>
    • </nowiki>[https://img.pvme.io/images/y39uBQHO8g.mp4 <nowiki>Click to view an example of HM rockfall</nowiki>]
</div></div><div><div><u><nowiki>Upheaval and Rubble</nowiki></u>
</div><div style="white-space:pre-line;"><nowiki>Used in the south-west chamber.
⬥ The mole will use a rubble attack at the ground near the player's position. This has a 5x5 AoE centred on the player's position and deals 200 hard typeless damage every two ticks. During the attack she will also dive into the ground once, reappearing in another spot. In Hard Mode the damage is doubled from 200 to 400, and she dives twice instead of once. The player should:
    • Move away from the area to avoid the attack.
⬥ This attack will also occur if you aren't in attack range of the Giant Mole at any point during the fight.
    • </nowiki>[https://img.pvme.io/images/XdcYnY6ORi.mp4 <nowiki>Click to view an example of Upheaval</nowiki>]
</div></div></div>
</div>

</div><div style="margin:1.6em 0 2.2em;margin:1.4em 0;padding:1em 1.2em;border:1px solid #8ca69b;border-left:5px solid #4d7b6b;border-radius:6px;background-color:rgba(110,145,127,0.08);">

== <span style="padding:0.15em 0 0.35em;line-height:1.35;"><ins style="text-decoration:none;"><nowiki>Presets and Relics</nowiki></ins></span> ==

<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki>[https://presets.pvme.io/?id=aZpSCcQFoRf9I3PoO7JE <nowiki>Magic preset</nowiki>] <span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="magic">[[File:Magic.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>magic</nowiki>|<nowiki>magic</nowiki>]]</span><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;max-width:100%;width:700px;margin:0.9em 0;" title="giant mole basic magic">https://files.catbox.moe/tlpk1n.webp<span class="pvme-export-media-meta" style="display:block;font-size:0.85em;">[https://pvme.io/preset-maker-storage/embeds/images/7dc77c4edefa6680c23c4010d7a1a3419182b9dbaeee8ce6debca0bf46ca9919.webp Image source]</span></span></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki>[https://presets.pvme.io/?id=ViQQNzWIjQiyLnjHu8kW <nowiki>Necromancy preset</nowiki>] <span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="necromancy">[[File:Necromancy.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1148995625896120460.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>necromancy</nowiki>|<nowiki>necromancy</nowiki>]]</span>
<span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;max-width:100%;width:540px;margin:0.9em 0;">https://files.catbox.moe/rs5tis.png<span class="pvme-export-media-meta" style="display:block;font-size:0.85em;">[https://firebasestorage.googleapis.com/v0/b/preset-images/o/images%2FViQQNzWIjQiyLnjHu8kW.png?alt=media Image source]</span></span></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;height:0;overflow:hidden;margin:0;line-height:0;"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
</div><div style="margin:1.6em 0 2.2em;">
<span id="tips-and-tricks" style="display:block;height:0;overflow:hidden;line-height:0;"></span>
== <span style="padding:0.15em 0 0.35em;line-height:1.35;"><ins style="text-decoration:none;"><nowiki>Tips and Tricks</nowiki></ins></span> ==

<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>The Giant Mole can teach you to respond to game cues like message pop-ups and some movement, but is mostly an easy boss to get your first taste of bossing or boss kill count.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;height:0;overflow:hidden;margin:0;line-height:0;"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>One hurdle for faster kills will be moving between the different chambers quickly, which is where mobility abilities such as </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="surge">[[File:Surge.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533810004262912.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>surge</nowiki>|<nowiki>surge</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> and </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="dive">[[File:Dive.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1049378668197195808.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>dive</nowiki>|<nowiki>dive</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> can help a lot.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;height:0;overflow:hidden;margin:0;line-height:0;"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>Your options for dealing damage will vary greatly depending on your gear and unlocked abilities.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ When using </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="magic">[[File:Magic.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>magic</nowiki>|<nowiki>magic</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki>:</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Use strong threshold magic abilities such as </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="wm">[[File:Wild Magic.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533809978966037.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>wm</nowiki>|<nowiki>wm</nowiki>]]</span> <span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="asphyx">[[File:Asphyxiate.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533833072672778.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>asphyx</nowiki>|<nowiki>asphyx</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> when available.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• You can make Giant Mole walk while </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="comb">[[File:Combust.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533833098100745.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>comb</nowiki>|<nowiki>comb</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> is active for more damage too</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• A god staff special attack </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="gstaff">[[File:Guthix staff.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513203008608141314.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>gstaff</nowiki>|<nowiki>gstaff</nowiki>]]</span> <span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="spec">[[File:Weapon Special Attack.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537340400273195028.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>spec</nowiki>|<nowiki>spec</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> is a hard-hitting attack if unlocked</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ When using </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="necromancy">[[File:Necromancy.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1148995625896120460.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>necromancy</nowiki>|<nowiki>necromancy</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki>:</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Build </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="necrosis">[[File:Necrosis.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1139452791878856805.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>necrosis</nowiki>|<nowiki>necrosis</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> stacks, using </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="touchofdeath">[[File:Touch of Death.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809175980810380.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>touchofdeath</nowiki>|<nowiki>touchofdeath</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> to then use </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="fingerofdeath">[[File:Finger of Death.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159434801938432010.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>fingerofdeath</nowiki>|<nowiki>fingerofdeath</nowiki>]]</span></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Build </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="residualsoul">[[File:Residual Soul.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1139453152169558046.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>residualsoul</nowiki>|<nowiki>residualsoul</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> stacks, then use </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="volleyofsouls">[[File:Volley of Souls.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159435029592686642.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>volleyofsouls</nowiki>|<nowiki>volleyofsouls</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> (or </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="soulstrike">[[File:Soul Strike.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809142376058910.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>soulstrike</nowiki>|<nowiki>soulstrike</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki>)</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;height:0;overflow:hidden;margin:0;line-height:0;"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
